proposed.paraphrase: SANHA classifies lecithin (E322) as Halaal, noting its predominant commercial source is soybean (also derived from eggs and leguminous seeds) — i.e. named plant/soy lecithin is halal.

proposed.sourceName: Darul Fiqh — 'Is soy lecithin halal?' (Mufti Faraz Adam)
proposed.paraphrase: The fatwa rules soy lecithin permissible because it is derived from soya, a vegetable source; lecithin from egg yolks or plant sources is likewise permissible (only animal-source lecithin depends on the body part and manner of slaughter).

researcherNote: E322 plant origin (soy/sunflower/egg, named) = grade 1 Halal. Determinate plant origin (not origin-undeterminable, so NOT blocked by 8.4). All madhabs treat soy/sunflower lecithin as halal without reservation. Two independent tier-1 sources (SANHA national authority + Darul Fiqh). APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01.
